title: MODE_WORLD_READABLE / MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE
description: Files or preferences readable by other apps (blocked with a SecurityException from Android 7).
remediation: Use MODE_PRIVATE and FileProvider for sharing.
falsePositives: Reference in code that does not run on recent versions.

title: World-accessible file mode (literal 1, 2 or 3)
description: JADX often writes constants as numbers: 1 = MODE_WORLD_READABLE, 2 = MODE_WORLD_WRITEABLE.
falsePositives: openOrCreateDatabase has another signature (CursorFactory): check which overload is called.

title: SQL built by concatenation
description: Concatenating data into SQL allows injection when part of it comes from outside (for example from an exported ContentProvider).
falsePositives: Concatenation of constants only, or of numeric values already validated.

title: PendingIntent without FLAG_IMMUTABLE
description: A mutable PendingIntent handed to another app can have its inner Intent changed and be executed with this app's identity.
remediation: Use FLAG_IMMUTABLE, unless mutability is required (then use an explicit Intent).
falsePositives: Flags coming from a variable cannot be evaluated (low confidence); FLAG_MUTABLE may be intentional.

title: sendBroadcast without a permission
description: An implicit broadcast without a permission can be received by any app.
remediation: Use an explicit Intent (setPackage) or a receiver permission.
falsePositives: Intents with setPackage/ComponentName set outside this line.

title: Reading Intent data in an exported component
description: Untrusted input source: the component is exported, so other apps control this Intent. There is no flow analysis; follow the data manually.
remediation: Validate every Intent field before using it (URLs, paths, class names, nested Intents).
falsePositives: Data used only for display or validated right afterwards.
